intervention.rule: Keep the production 0.20 regret trigger for every rewind. Also admit regret at least 0.15 only when the exact causal sibling is at most six gaps behind the current prefix.
intervention.difference_from_closed_cap_seven: Remove the rewind-seven lower-trigger shell; all other policy behavior is identical.

design_basis.interpretation: The removed shell costs more than the entire retained shallow set and usually restores the interrupted prefix. This is a categorical work/value boundary observed before the cap-six live outcomes.

predeclared_screen.decision: Advance only if all cells retain validity, the full-catalog score sum is positive, and the direction is not carried by one isolated cell. This is the last fixed rewind-cap dose in the family; failure closes the family rather than moving the cap again.
